crossRefs.note: Behold, the former things have happened and I declare new things. I tell you about them before they come up.”
Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the peoples be assembled. Who among them can declare this, and show…
Declare and present it. Yes, let them take counsel together. Who has shown this from ancient time? Who has declared it…
“Assemble yourselves, all of you, and hear! Who among them has declared these things? He whom Yahweh loves will do what…
From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.
He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine, and will declare it to you.

translations.web: “Let them announce and declare to us what will happen! Declare the former things, what they are, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or show us things to come.
translations.bsb: “Let them come and tell us what will happen. Tell the former things, so that we may reflect on them and know the outcome. Or announce to us what is coming.
translations.kjv: Let them bring them forth, and shew us what shall happen: let them shew the former things, what they be, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or declare us things for to come.
translations.asv: Let them bring forth, and declare unto us what shall happen: declare ye the former things, what they are, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or show us things to come.
